description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, following the demolition of existing single storey rear conservatory; installation of 3no. rooflights in the rear roofslope; erection of a single storey outbuilding in the rear garden; associated alterations and landscaping; Replacement of all existing timber framed windows with UPVC windows; replacement of existing main front entrance door. (amended description)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans and drawings listed in this decision notice, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission.

Drawings: 

A-101;
A-102;
A-103;
A-111;
A-201;
A-202;
A-052;
A-082;
A-211.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Ground floor rear extension - London stock brick to match the existing building 

Outbuilding - London stock brick to match the main building 

Replacement Windows: uPVC framed windows, colour, style, detail and finish to match the existing windows to be replaced.

Front door: Composite door to match existing 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC6 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).


Condition : 4 - The rooflights hereby approved to the rear roofslope shall not protrude more than 150mm above the roof-slope they are installed within. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018)."
Condition : 5 - The outbuilding located in the rear of the rear garden hereby approved shall only be used in connection with, and incidental/ancillary  to, the use of the dwellinghouse. In particular the outbuilding shall not be occupied as a self-contained unit  that is separate and distinct from the use of the property as a residential dwelling.   

The use of the outbuilding as a self-contained unit, separate from the use of the property as a dwelling, would raise materially different planning considerations that the Council would wish to consider under a full planning application , in accordance with Policies HO1, T4, CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - No part of any roof of the single storey rear extension and outbuilding hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs.  

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).
